faqs.a: Our standard production turnaround is 10 to 14 business days from digital proof approval. We also offer rush 5-7 business day service for urgent team or corporate event deadlines.
Yes! We provide 100% free tracked courier delivery worldwide on all custom patch orders. You never pay unexpected customs or freight surcharges.

faqs.q: Can I get a sample before bulk order?
faqs.a: Absolutely. We send high-resolution digital embroidery scan proofs for every order with unlimited revisions. Pre-production physical sewn samples can also be manufactured and mailed for master verification.

faqs.q: What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
faqs.a: Our minimum order is just 10 patches. For maximum value, our wholesale discount tiers unlock at 50, 100, 250, 500, and 1,000+ units.

faqs.q: What artwork formats do you accept?
faqs.a: We accept AI, EPS, PDF, SVG, PSD, PNG, and JPG. Even if you only have a rough sketch or smartphone photo, our in-house digitizers will vectorize and optimize it free of charge.

faqs.q: Will my colors match my brand guidelines?
faqs.a: Yes! We match Pantone (PMS) color codes using Madeira Polyneon threads with over 400 vivid standard thread colors available.
